# Contract

`sales.obj.core.contract` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **core**

> The executed agreement and everything it commits both sides to. The discriminator against a Proposal is enforceability and direction: a proposal is an argument we make, a contract is a set of promises we must keep and can be held to. Non-standard clauses agreed to win a deal are a liability that outlives the rep who agreed them — renegotiated from that new baseline at every renewal, inherited by a delivery team that was not in the room, and discovered by finance in the quarter they bite. That is why obligations and non-standard terms are first-class properties here and not a footnote on the document record.


Also called: `Agreement`, `MSA`, `Order Form`, `Paper`, `Executed Agreement`

## Constraints

- **`ct.signature_requires_authority`** Cannot execute with a signatory whose approval limitis below total_contract_value.
- **`ct.no_forecast_before_execution`** Nothing before executed_at may enter the committedforecast.
- **`ct.template_deviation_needs_approval`** No clause outside the template may be agreedwithout a named approver.
- **`ct.amendment_inherits_parent`** An amendment inherits every term of its parent contract,including prior concessions.
- **`ct.notice_window_is_immovable`** The renewal notice date cannot be extended unilaterally.Missing it decides the outcome without a conversation.
- **`ct.verbal_terms_do_not_survive`** Anything promised verbally and absent from the executeddocument is unenforceable in both directions.


## Business rules

- **`ct.signatory_must_have_authority`** The counterparty signatory's approval_limit must cover total_contract_value, verified from an independent source. A signature from someone who cannot bind the company is worse than none because it stops the search for someone who can.
- **`ct.nonstandard_clause_requires_named_approval`** Any clause outside the template requires a named approver recorded against the deal before agreement. Not a verbal nod and not a Slack reaction — the person who agreed it must be findable three years later when it is renegotiated.
- **`ct.no_countersign_during_open_security_review`** Do not countersign while a security review is open. The remediation commitments that come out of it become obligations, and obligations agreed after signature are agreed with no leverage.
- **`ct.renewal_notice_must_be_diarised`** On execution, renewal_notice_days before end_date must become a dated Next Action with an owner. An auto-renewing contract with no diarised notice date is an outcome decided by whoever remembers first.
- **`ct.verbal_yes_is_not_a_contract`** A verbal yes may not move a deal into the committed forecast. Nothing before executed_at is revenue.
- **`ct.obligations_become_actions`** Every obligation must exist as a Next Action with an owner and a date within one working day of execution, or it will be discovered at the renewal conversation by the customer.

## Actions

- **Send the contract** (human) —
- **Verify signing authority** (human) — Check approval_limitagainst total_contract_value from an independent source. Cheap, skipped constantly, and the cause of the ugliest late-stage restarts.
- **Ask for their paper process** (human) — Who reviews,in what order, how long each step takes. The question that converts a close date from a hope into a schedule.
- **Escalate a stalled redline commercially** (human) — Past three rounds the disagreement is commercial. Send the economic buyer, not another lawyer.
- **Trade term for price** (human) — Concede term length, payment timing or reference rights before price. Only price resets the renewal baseline permanently.
- **Record a non-standard clause and its approver** (human) — Takes a minute now and is the only reason anyone can decline the same ask in three years.
- **Turn obligations into dated actions** (agent) — Onexecution. The single highest-leverage automation on this object.
- **Diarise the renewal notice date** (system) —

## Metrics

- **request_to_signature_days** (days) — Contract requested to executed. The mostcompressible segment of the cycle and the least measured.
- **redline_rounds_per_deal** (count) — Rounds by segment. Rising rounds usuallymeans the template is behind the market.
- **nonstandard_clause_rate** (percent) — Share of contracts deviating from template.A portfolio risk number, not a deal one.
- **obligation_completion_rate** (percent) — Contractual obligations met on time.The strongest leading indicator of renewal there is.
- **notice_window_hit_rate** (percent) — Renewal notice dates actioned before thedeadline. Unmeasurable today.
- **signature_slip_rate** (percent) — Deals forecast to close that sat in awaiting_signaturepast the quarter.


## Examples

- **Standard order form under an existing MSA** — Days, not weeks. The MSA already absorbedevery argument, which is the entire reason land-and-expand motions close faster.
- **First contract with an enterprise, full legal review** — Six to twelve weeks and threeredline rounds. Predictable, and predictably left out of the close date.
- **Uncapped liability conceded to close a quarter** — Signed on a Friday by someone wholeft within the year. Renegotiated at every renewal from that baseline. The clearest case of a term outliving the rep who agreed it.
- **Auto-renewing contract, 60-day notice, undiarised** — The classic misclassification— reported as a happy renewal right up to the week the customer gives notice with two days to spare.
- **Signed by a director with a limit below the value** — Reads as a closed deal and isa restart. Looks worse than never having sent it, because the search for a real approver stopped.

## Metadata

> Seven of eleven patterns are executable; four are blocked, and they share one cause — Layer 2 instruments the START of the paper process well (contract_requested, legal_review, security_review_started) and is entirely blind after signature. The single highest-value gap is structured clause extraction (contract.clause.nonstandard plus a clause_conceded observation): without it the nonstandard_clauses list is filled in by whoever remembers, which is nobody, and this object's central thesis — that concessions outlive the people who make them — is unserved. A close second is contract_signed, which decision-maker.yaml also asks for: the most important state change in the whole revenue motion is invisible to the engine, so the obligation, renewal and onboarding clocks all have to be started by hand.
